G2102.def: adverb from «2101»; quite agreeably:--acceptably, + please well.

G2103.def: from «2095» and «1014»; good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian:--Eubulus.

G2104.def: from «2095» and «1096»; well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous:--more noble, nobleman.

G2105.et: feminine from (2095) and the alternate of (2203) (as the god of the weather)
G2105.def: feminine from «2095» and the alternate of «2203» (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather:--fair weather.

G2106.def: from «2095» and «1380»; to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing):--think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.

G2107.et: from a presumed compound of (2095) and the base of (1380)
G2107.def: from a presumed compound of «2095» and the base of «1380»; satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose:--desire, good pleasure (will), × seem good.

G2108.def: from «2110»; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good deed done.

G2110.def: from «2095» and the base of «2041»; a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist:--benefactor.

G2111.def: from «2095» and a derivative of «5087»; well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate:--fit, meet.

G2112.def: adverb from «2117»; directly, i.e. at once or soon:--anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

G2113.def: from «2117» and «1408»; to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct:--(come) with a straight course.

G2114.def: from «2115»; to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully:--be of good cheer (merry).

G2115.def: from «2095» and «2372»; in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful:--of good cheer, the more cheerfully.

G2116.def: from «2117»; to straighten (level); technically, to steer:--governor, make straight.

G2117.def: perhaps from «2095» and «5087»; straight, i.e. (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once:--anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.

G2119.def: from «2121»; to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure:--have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

G2121.def: from «2095» and «2540»; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time of need.

G2123.et: comparative of a compound of (2095) and (2873)
G2123.def: comparative of a compound of «2095» and «2873»; better for toil, i.e. more facile:--easier.

G2124.def: from «2126»; properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely):--fear(-ed).

G2125.def: middle voice from «2126»; to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence:--(moved with) fear.

G2126.def: from «2095» and «2983»; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious):--devout.

G2127.def: from a compound of «2095» and «3056»; to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper):--bless, praise.

G2129.def: from the same as «2127»; fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess:--blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

G2130.et: from (2095) and a presumed derivative of (3330)
G2130.def: from «2095» and a presumed derivative of «3330»; good at imparting, i.e. liberal:--ready to distribute.

G2131.def: from «2095» and «3529»; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.

G2132.def: from a compound of «2095» and «3563»; to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile:--agree.

G2133.def: from the same as «2132»; kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty:--benevolence, good will.

G2135.def: from eune (a bed) and «2192»; a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer):--eunuch.

G2136.def: from the same as «2137»; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman:--Euodias.

G2137.def: from a compound of «2095» and «3598»; to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs:--(have a) prosper(-ous journey).

G2138.def: from «2095» and «3982»; good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint:--easy to be intreated.

G2139.et: from (2095) and a derivative of a presumed compound of (4012) and (2476)
G2139.def: from «2095» and a derivative of a presumed compound of «4012» and «2476»; well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case):--which doth so easily beset.

G2140.def: from a compound of «2095» and «4160»; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do good.

G2141.et: from a compound of (2090) and the base of (4197)
G2141.def: from a compound of «2090» and the base of «4197»; (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means:--ability.

G2142.def: from the same as «2141»; pecuniary resources:--wealth.

G2143.def: from a compound of «2095» and «4241»; good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness:--grace.

G2144.def: from «2095» and a derivative of «4327»; well-received, i.e. approved, favorable:--acceptable(-ted).

G2145.def: from «2095» and the same as «4332»; sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service):--X attend upon.

G2146.def: from a compound of «2095» and «4383»; to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display:--make a fair show.

G2147.et: a prolonged form of a primary heuro {hyoo'-ro}, which (together with another cognate form heureo {hyoo-reh'-o}) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect
G2147.def: to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive, see.

G2148.def: from Euros (the east wind) and «2830»; a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter:--Euroklydon.

G2150.def: from «2152»; piety; specially, the gospel scheme:--godliness, holiness.

G2151.def: from «2152»; to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support):--show piety, worship.

G2152.def: from «2095» and «4576»; well-reverent, i.e. pious:--devout, godly.

G2154.def: from «2095» and the base of «4591»; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant:--easy to be understood.

G2155.def: from «2095» and «4698»; well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic:--pitiful, tender-hearted.

G2158.def: from «2095» and «4976»; well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank):--comely, honourable.

G2159.et: from a compound of (2095) and a derivative of teino (to stretch)
G2159.def: adverb from a compound of «2095» and a derivative of teino (to stretch); in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely):--mightily, vehemently.

G2160.et: from a compound of (2095) and a derivative of the base of (5157) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose)
G2160.def: from a compound of «2095» and a derivative of the base of «5157» (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry:--jesting.

G2161.def: from «2095» and a derivative of «5177»; well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.

G2162.def: from «2163»; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good report.

G2163.def: from «2095» and «5345»; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.

G2164.def: from «2095» and «5409»; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth abundantly.

G2165.def: from «2095» and «5424»; to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice:--fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.

G2166.def: of foreign origin (compare «06578»); Euphrates, a river of Asia:--Euphrates.

G2167.def: from the same as «2165»; joyfulness:--gladness, joy.

G2168.def: from «2170»; to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal:--(give) thank(-ful, -s).

G2169.def: from «2170»; gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship):--thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).

G2170.def: from «2095» and a derivative of «5483»; well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful:--thankful.

G2171.def: from «2172»; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation:--prayer, vow.

G2172.et: middle voice of a primary verb
G2172.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to God:--pray, will, wish.

G2173.def: from «2095» and «5543»; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for use.

G2174.def: from a compound of «2095» and «5590»; to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged:--be of good comfort.

G2175.et: from a compound of (2095) and a derivative of (3605)
G2175.def: from a compound of «2095» and a derivative of «3605»; good-scentedness, i.e. fragrance:--sweet savour (smell, -smelling).

G2176.def: from «2095» and «3686»; properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand:--(on the) left.

G2177.def: from «1909» and «242»; to spring upon:--leap on.

G2178.def: from «1909» and «530»; upon one occasion (only):--(at) once (for all).

G2179.def: from «2181»; Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus:--of Ephesus.

G2180.def: from «2181»; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus.

G2181.def: probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor:--Ephesus.

G2182.def: from a compound of «1909» and «2147»; a discoverer, i.e. contriver:--inventor.

G2183.def: from «2184»; diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families:--course.

G2184.def: from «1909» and «2250»; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.

G2185.def: from «1909» and a cognate of «2240»; to arrive upon, i.e. extend to:--reach.

G2186.def: from «1909» and «2476»; to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal); --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

G2187.def: of Hebrew origin (669 or better «06085»); Ephraim, a place in Palestine:--Ephraim.

G2188.pos:
1. be thou opened
    1. receive the power of hearing, the ears of the deaf and the eyes of the blind being considered as closed

G2189.def: feminine of «2190»; hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition:--enmity, hatred.

G2190.et: from a primary echtho (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile)
G2190.def: from a primary echtho (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan):--enemy, foe.

G2191.def: of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively):--viper.

G2192.et: including an alternate form scheo {skheh'-o}, used in certain tenses only), a primary verb
G2192.def: a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition):--be (able, × hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), × conceive, count, diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, + return, × sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.

G2193.def: of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).

G2194.def: of Hebrew origin («02074»); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of Palestine:--Zabulon.

G2195.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «02140»); Zacchaeus, an Israelite:--Zacchaeus.

G2196.def: of Hebrew origin («02226»); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara.

G2197.def: of Hebrew origin («02148»); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites:--Zacharias.

G2198.def: a primary verb; to live (literally or figuratively):--life(-time), (a-)live(-ly), quick.

G2199.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «02067»); Zebedaeus, an Israelite:--Zebedee.
